scientific_integrity: The two infinite limits are supported by explicit analytic conditioning and lattice local-limit arguments, not inferred from finite enumeration. A standard-library exact finite checker is supplied. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The results concern a fixed even-time return of a non-lazy uniform coordinate-flip walk, not first return, nonuniform weights, or unvisited vertices. The fixed-density centering uses the exact time/dimension ratio, and no quantitative asymptotic rate is proved. Historical priority is qualified by inaccessible older sample-path full text.
title: Return bridges double the missing-direction intensity at hypercube coverage
